info.name: Webforge – Workshop Management API (P12)
info.description:
Run `npm run seed` first, then run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner.

Auth uses an HTTP-only cookie: Postman stores it automatically after each login, and each folder logs in as the role it needs.

Seeded accounts: admin@webforge.dev / Admin@123 · spot1@webforge.dev / Spot@1234 · aarav@student.dev, diya@student.dev ... / User@1234

exec: pm.test('success: false + error object', () => { pm.expect(json.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(json.error).to.be.an('object'); });

item.name: 04 Spot Registrar – Event Day
item.description: Roster, check-in, present, no-show swap (seed: "Git & GitHub Workflow (LIVE)").

exec: pm.test('LIVE workshop assigned + window open', () => { pm.expect(live).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(live.windowOpen).to.eql(true); pm.expect(live.canMarkNoShow).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('next in line is the PRESENT person, not #1', () => { pm.expect(json.data.nextInLine.present).to.eql(true); pm.expect(json.data.nextInLine.position).to.be.above(1); });
pm.test('success: false + error object', () => { pm.expect(json.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(json.error).to.be.an('object'); });
